## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.17

This release adds a first Dependency Manager pass in the Config tab.

### Added

- Central external-tool status dialog for MKVToolNix, FFmpeg/FFprobe, MakeMKV, Tesseract, `seconv`, and Subtitle Edit.
- Detected status, requirement level, version, resolved path, and diagnostic details for each dependency.
- Official download-page shortcuts for selected tools.

### Notes

- This is intentionally a safe first step: it diagnoses and links to official download pages, but does not download or install tools automatically yet.
